The '''S18 light freighter''', created by the [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation]], was a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in use around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[44 ABY]]. In that year, it was used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] to [[Skirmish near Ashteri's Cloud|ambush]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] in an attempt to capture the ''[[Rockhound]]'' following the conclusion of their [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The S18 [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] could house up to six [[BDY crew skiff]]s.
